Cobra Can: Cortech Cobra Can Trash Receptacle (Combined)
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-cobra-can-food-grade-general-use-trash-receptacle
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/facilities-maintenance/cobra-can/
Spec sheets: Cobra Can Flame Retardant, Cobra Can Food Grade and General Use
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Cobra Can Trash Receptacle, Flame Retardant or Food Grade and General Use
Current H1: Cortech Cobra Can Food Grade Trash Receptacle - General Use
Subtitle: Virtually Unbreakable Molded Trash Can in Nine Sizes from 20 to 55 Gallons, in Flame Retardant or Food Grade Material
Current subtitle: Cortech USA Cobra Trash Cans - Trash Receptacle Suitable For Food Service or General Use
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Cobra Can Trash Receptacle is a virtually unbreakable trash can for correctional facilities, behavioral healthcare facilities, kitchens, and other high-abuse settings. It comes in nine sizes from 20 to 55 gallons, in flame retardant material that passes California Technical Bulletin 133 or in food grade and general use material.
The can is rotationally molded from structural polyethylene for strength with some flexibility. Molded-in handles run around the entire can and its underside for easier lifting, and molded-in floor glides reduce floor scratching when the can is dragged. An optional Cobra Can dolly makes full cans easy to roll.
Material: Rotationally molded structural polyethylene; 0.22” nominal wall thickness
Sizes: 20, 22, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, or 55 gallons
Material Options: Flame retardant or food grade and general use
Handles: 360° molded-in continuous handles around the entire can perimeter and underside
Floor Glides: Molded-in floor glides reduce floor scratching when the can is dragged
Durability: Virtually unbreakable
Flame Retardant Version: Passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB; tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Colors: Flame retardant in Blue Gray (also available in Green or Blue); food grade and general use in Blue, Green, Red, White, Yellow, or Black (custom colors available on request)
Dolly: Optional Cobra Can dolly, sold separately: DCC for 20 to 30 gallon cans or DCCL for 35 to 55 gallon cans
Warranty: 10-year factory warranty
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
Flame Retardant, Blue Gray: 20200FR, 22200FR, 25200FR, 30200FR, 35200FR, 40200FR, 45200FR, 50200FR, and 55200FR (20 to 55 gallons)
Food Grade and General Use, Blue: 20620B, 22620B, 25620B, 30620B, 35620B, 40620B, 45620B, 50620B, and 55620B (20 to 55 gallons)
Cobra Can Dolly (optional): DCC for 20 to 30 gallon cans; DCCL for 35 to 55 gallon cans
[H2] Applications
The Cobra Can suits secure facilities and kitchens that need a trash can that will not break, with a flame retardant version for areas that must meet flammability standards.
Typical applications include:
Housing units, dayrooms, and common areas in correctional facilities and jails
Kitchens, dining halls, and food service areas
Behavioral healthcare facilities and other high-abuse settings
Explore Anchortex's Prison Janitorial and Sanitation Supplies and Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collections for more trash receptacles and sanitation supplies.
[H2] About Cortech Facilities Maintenance
Cortech facilities maintenance products are molded to stand up to hard daily use in correctional facilities, behavioral healthcare facilities, and other high-abuse settings.
Cortech facilities maintenance includes:
Trash Receptacles: Cobra Cans in 20 to 55 gallon sizes, in flame retardant or food grade and general use material, and Cobra Mini Cans in 10 and 14 quart sizes
Can Dollies: Cobra Can dollies in two sizes
Carts: Kangaroo Carts and lids for laundry, trash, and material handling
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (58 characters): Cortech Cobra Can Heavy Duty Trash Receptacle at Anchortex
Meta description (148 characters): Shop the Cortech Cobra Can. A virtually unbreakable molded trash can in nine sizes from 20 to 55 gallons, in flame retardant or food grade material.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Facilities Maintenance" is a new section for the Cobra Can, Cobra Mini Can, can dolly, and Kangaroo Cart pages. It is the same on each of these pages.
Combined page: as you asked, this page covers both Cobra Cans (flame retardant and food grade and general use) and mentions the dolly as an option, with no dolly variants. It keeps this page’s address. The Cobra Can Flame Retardant and Cobra Can Dolly pages will be deleted and redirected here.
Variants: I will add the nine flame retardant variants from the Cobra Can Flame Retardant page to this page, with their SKUs (C601098-01 to -09) and current prices, so this page has 18 variants: 9 flame retardant and 9 food grade and general use.
Flame retardant variant names: they say "Gray." The Cortech spec sheet says "Blue Gray." Would you like them renamed, for example "20200FR - 20 gal Blue Gray"?
Price per case: your note on the Dolly tab says "Price is per case." The Cortech spec sheets do not say the Cobra Cans are sold in cases. Should this page say the price is per case?
H1: Cortech calls it the Cobra Can. I named both materials in the H1. There are 18 model numbers, so I left them out of the H1.
Weight and size: the Cortech spec sheets say "See Chart" for the weight but have no chart, so I left weights and dimensions out and made a note on the worksheet.
Collection links: the can is in your Prison Janitorial and Sanitation Supplies and Kitchen and Food Service collections, so I linked those two.
Product images: this page has one image (55 gallon, Blue). I will add the flame retardant can photo (22 gallon) from the other page and the Cortech dolly photo.
